payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW round 2 does not converge. The revision closes the prior nullability, JavaScript representation, audit, privileged-route, egress-class, and RPO/RTO findings, and strict OpenSpec validation still passes. Ten critical implementation blockers remain: decimal strings exceed signed BIGINT and generation+1 can overflow; duplicated queue correlation fields can disagree; process-health rows cannot encode their two retention classes; the operator credential has no owning configuration package; the frozen all-operation inventory omits side-effecting operator scripts; coverage packages cannot write their required tests; integration's declared union is incomplete; the six-hour soak has a four-hour timeout and references an unowned validator; the distributed 2 MiB trace cap is unenforceable; and the CONNECT proxy is not a concrete pinned topology component. External multi-vendor dispatch remains policy-blocked, so the safe consensus is single-reviewer and lacks quorum.
completed_work: Re-read every revised artifact and compared revision 3 against the first PLAN_REVIEW findings.
Verified the previous nullability, root-span, audit constraint, operator-route, ownership API, egress class, process-health bound, and RPO/RTO edits.
Demonstrated locally that both JSON Schema and the generated Pydantic model accept 9999999999999999999 despite the signed-BIGINT claim.
Cross-checked the frozen entrypoint inventory against existing side-effecting scripts and mapped package test/write scopes against tasks and verification commands.
Wrote twelve structured findings across correctness, architecture, security, and readability; ten are critical with disposition fix.
Validated review-findings-plan.json against openspec/schemas/review-findings.schema.json and verified severity-prefix/disposition coherence.
Did not retry the prohibited external vendor dispatch; regenerated a safe single-reviewer consensus and recorded the constraint in review-manifest.json.

decisions.title: Outcome remains not_converged
decisions.rationale: The remaining defects are contract and package-execution blockers, not optional implementation details. The consensus tool reports zero confirmed blockers only because policy prevents a second external reviewer; severity and direct repository evidence govern the phase outcome.

decisions.title: Universal coverage includes explicit bootstrap classification
decisions.rationale: A claimed frozen inventory cannot omit secret seeding, external environment mutation, and OAuth setup while allowing only probe/static exclusions. Commands that cannot initialize PostgreSQL must receive a safe bootstrap evidence path or a documented bounded exclusion.

decisions.title: Distributed trace size must be enforced at an owned boundary
decisions.rationale: A process-local helper cannot account for a trace spanning services, retries, and restarts. The plan must use enforceable per-observation/per-attempt limits or choose a centralized collector with explicit degradation priorities.

next_steps: PLAN_ITERATE: bound decimal strings to signed BIGINT, reserve generation+1 headroom, and add exact max/max+1 cross-artifact tests.
PLAN_ITERATE: remove duplicate queue correlation or enforce equality between row identity, JSON context, and indexed trace fields; add process lifecycle_kind/expires_at for health cleanup.
PLAN_ITERATE: give operator authorization/configuration/OpenBao rotation one owning package and serialize runtime dependencies.
PLAN_ITERATE: complete the executable inventory, add explicit bootstrap exclusions/fallbacks, and repair ingestion/operational/integration write scopes from a mechanically validated union.
PLAN_ITERATE: assign validate_acceptance.py, extend the soak timeout beyond six hours, and make commands create their declared evidence.
PLAN_ITERATE: replace the distributed trace-wide cap with an enforceable owned budget and select a concrete pinned CONNECT proxy with health, secret, logging, reload, and failure contracts.
Re-run PLAN_REVIEW; external vendor quorum requires explicit permission to share repository plan details with configured vendor services.
